name: pi-multi-code-review
description: Pi skill + subagent: three parallel code-review channels (OCR / Standards / Spec) reviewing the same diff bound under one scope, then an oracle deduplicates, resolves conflicts and re-grades them into a single adjudicated report (00-adjudication.md). Pure
